item.title: Doubao-Seedance-1.0-pro-fast
item.description: Doubao-Seedance-1.0-pro-fast is a faster, cheaper version of Seedance 1.0 Pro, up to about 3x quicker, with multi-shot generation. It runs on Volcano Ark.
